analyst.summary: Vodafone Idea's headline profit this year came from a one-time accounting gain tied to the government's AGR dues relief, not from the underlying business turning profitable -- excluding that gain, the company has posted a net loss every quarter, still carries negative net worth, and needs far more capital than it has raised so far to fund its network build-out. Subscriber and ARPU trends are improving, which is worth watching, but the balance-sheet risk keeps this a Sell.
